entries.text: After taking an object, verify it is actually in your inventory (e.g., via inventory) before attempting to place or use it; if the take action fails silently, retry taking the object from its location, and if a subsequent put/move fails, check whether your hands are full by attempting to take another object.

If a "put" action repeatedly fails despite being at the correct location and holding the object, try the alternative phrasing "move <object> to <receptacle>"; if that also fails, try a different valid receptacle of the same type, and if the receptacle is a container, ensure it is open first.
